subject: WRITE statement
notes: GAP -> CONFORMS (kb/Work PB909). Rule text validated: cite.py --check 14.9.51.3 "If the organization of the write file is indexed or relative, format 2 shall be specified" -> OK 3). Format 2 differs from Format 1 only by lacking the ADVANCING and END-OF-PAGE phrases (and admitting INVALID KEY, which SR2 screens on the other arm), so refusing those two phrases on a relative/indexed WRITE IS the rule. COBOL1720 in both lanes (Format 2 gives a print-control phrase no meaning to bind under --permissive); it used to be a COBOL1756 deferral and a run-unit abort.
